scope: Independent read-only frozen source, recorded actual SDK tests/full semantic/schema evidence, API and README review. Not a production audit or live consensus claim.
coreChecks: GF(257) Lagrange interpolation uses distinct nonzero input points, exact bounded integer vectors and canonical basis.
Every declared point/column is re-evaluated, and the canonical first mismatch cannot activate an inconsistent stripe.
Current exact-certificate verification covers arbitrary field evaluation x including zero; it proves codeword membership, not authentic storage or error correction.
commonChecks: Commit-pinned namespace and strict JSON/UTF-8/schema/byte hashes bounded before computation.
Independent validator fresh-fetches full bytes and recomputes complete domain-bound results; leader digest or success bit alone is insufficient.
Owner immutable registration, permissionless one-shot certification, exact CAS/certificate activation and terminal revocation.
Bounded lifetime registrations/history; certificate includes protocol, chain, contract, owner, record, source URL+hash, revisions and timestamps.
Synthetic mock test URLs remain separate from public_url:null. No fabricated live/source/deployment claims.
